glossary.definition: (1) "Community mental health services provider or facility" means a community mental health services provider or facility that has its community mental health services certified by the department of mental health and addiction services under section 5119.36 of the Revised Code or by the department of children and youth under section 5103.03 of the Revised Code.
glossary.normalized: community mental health services provider or facility
glossary.term: Community mental health services provider or facility
